NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "352F81C04038A058676306A0C997B3B3", "In the ages before the fall, when prophecy still stirred among stone and fire, Dunzenkell priests were compelled by the voice of the Dawnfire herself to carve a sanctum around a Divine Gate of their own construction. Hidden deep within the Anvil Mountains, it was raised not in haste but in faith, a silent answer to ancient designs.

When the Ancients hurled the Harbingers from The Void and Verra burned beneath skies split by ash and Essence, four such gates awakened, and across the dying world, survivors fled toward them.

At the threshold in the Anvils, the dwarvish warriors held the line until the end. Those who passed through vanished into the non-magical, mundane world of Sanctus. The fate of those left behind is the stuff of legend.

Now, at last, the gate has opened once again, and the Exalted return to the world of their ancestors, and the reckoning long foretold.")
name: Anvils_AncientDunzenkel
